description: Make TestJavaScriptDurabilityDoesNotPersistSnapshotsByDefault and only confirmed sibling JavaScript orchestration functional tests deterministic by identifying the exact race mechanism, synchronizing on an observable lifecycle boundary instead of elapsed time, preserving the no-default-snapshot durability contract, and proving stability through repeated fresh runs and race detection.

context.customerAsk: Deflake TestJavaScriptDurabilityDoesNotPersistSnapshotsByDefault and any sibling JavaScript orchestration functional tests with the identical race shape. Reproduce and explain the failure mechanism, fix the root cause without sleeps or retries, prove 20 consecutive fresh durability package runs and a clean race-enabled run, and do not modify cmd/functionallane, Makefile functional targets, or shared wait helpers under tests/functional/internal/support.
context.problem: CI run 31426292402 job 93582274257 failed the required Backend Functional Coverage check in TestJavaScriptDurabilityDoesNotPersistSnapshotsByDefault after 6.24 seconds on an unrelated webhook-only PR. The test observes interrupted in-memory session state and then makes a negative filesystem assertion without yet proving that all relevant lifecycle, persistence, or cleanup work is quiescent. The exact competing operations still require direct diagnosis, but the nondeterministic check blocks innocent changes and wastes implementation and review time.
context.solution: Use repeated and race-enabled package runs plus bounded diagnostics to establish the exact causal interleaving. Replace the unsafe timing assumption with deterministic observation of the relevant public lifecycle, injected edge, or owned shutdown boundary. Preserve the behavioral proof that an interrupted JavaScript session remains inspectable in memory and default execution leaves no retired project-local durable-session snapshot. Fix product durability code only if evidence proves it owns the defect, and apply the correction only to siblings demonstrated to share the same mechanism.

acceptanceCriteria: The PR records the exact race mechanism behind the observed failure, including the competing operations, the premature or unsafe observation, and direct reproduction or diagnostic evidence connected to CI run 31426292402/job 93582274257.

TestJavaScriptDurabilityDoesNotPersistSnapshotsByDefault deterministically proves that an interrupted session remains inspectable in memory and default execution does not leave the retired project-local durable-session directory after relevant lifecycle activity is complete.

The root cause is fixed without a longer sleep, a retry of the negative filesystem assertion, relaxed expectations, or a timeout increase; any remaining polling is justified by a public observable transition rather than elapsed time alone.

Only sibling tests under tests/functional/orchestration/javascript demonstrated to share the identical race mechanism are corrected; if product durability code is proven responsible, the smallest owning-package fix has direct regression coverage.
The durability package passes 20 consecutive fresh -count=1 runs with loop output retained in the PR and completes cleanly under -race.

Quality gates pass: typecheck, focused functional tests, required CI, no NEW lint violations relative to current main, and the gates green on main (backend-size, pkg-maint, pkg-file-count, pkg-structure, vet) stay green.

The implementation/review loop continues until required CI is terminal and passing, all blocking PR conversation feedback is explicitly addressed, merge conflicts and shared-file changes are reconciled against current origin/main, and the PR is actually merged.

userStories.title: Establish the failure mechanism
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I need direct evidence of the durability test's failing interleaving so the correction removes the cause instead of concealing the symptom.
acceptanceCriteria: Run the durability package with -count=20 and with -race, preserving enough output and diagnostics to distinguish a test lifecycle race, shared-state collision, cleanup race, or product durability defect.

The investigation identifies the exact competing operations and the observation that can occur too early or concurrently, and the PR connects that mechanism to the CI assertion failure from run 31426292402/job 93582274257.

If the initial stress runs do not fail, targeted deterministic instrumentation or an isolated regression setup demonstrates the causal ordering without adding permanent sleeps or probabilistic failure expectations.

The selected correction stays within the JavaScript durability test boundary unless evidence proves an owning product durability defect, and it does not modify cmd/functionallane, Makefile functional targets, or tests/functional/internal/support.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Established the CI failure mechanism in tests/functional/orchestration/javascript/durability/resume_test.go. Backend Functional Coverage attempt 2 of run 31426292402 (job 93582274257) failed TestJavaScriptDurabilityDoesNotPersistSnapshotsByDefault at resume_test.go:208 because the provider did not observe cancellation; the exact race is that dispatch status RUNNING is published before the worker reaches the injected ProviderOverride Infer edge, so interrupt-dispatch can cancel the workflow context before the blocking Infer call starts. The durability provider now exposes deterministic infer-started and context-canceled channels, and the helper waits on those observable edge signals with bounded failure timers instead of polling or sleeping. The correction stays within the JavaScript durability test boundary and does not touch cmd/functionallane, Makefile functional targets, or tests/functional/internal/support. Baseline go test -count=20 runs passed for the no-snapshot test and the three durability siblings; post-change focused tests, the three-sibling package run, go vet, and go test -race all pass.

userStories.title: Make the default no-snapshot proof deterministic
userStories.description: As a contributor, I need the no-snapshot durability scenario to report only real product regressions so unrelated pull requests are not blocked by test timing.
acceptanceCriteria: The scenario waits for or induces a deterministic observable boundary that guarantees all operations relevant to the no-snapshot assertion have completed before inspecting persistence behavior.
The scenario still proves through public Factory Session behavior that the interrupted JavaScript session is inspectable in memory with INTERRUPTED status and interruption lifecycle data.
The scenario still proves that default execution does not leave the retired project-local durable-session directory or snapshot, and a deliberate regression of that behavior makes the test fail.
The correction does not add a longer sleep, retry the negative filesystem assertion, weaken the absence requirement, or increase a timeout to mask the race.

If the evidence locates the defect in product durability code, the fix preserves explicit lifecycle state and isolated persistence side effects in the owning service and includes a focused regression test at the narrowest effective layer.
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: Made the no-snapshot proof deterministic in tests/functional/orchestration/javascript/durability/resume_test.go. The injected blocking provider now exposes a completion signal that fires when the canceled Infer edge returns; TestJavaScriptDurabilityDoesNotPersistSnapshotsByDefault waits for that edge after the public INTERRUPTED lifecycle is observed before inspecting project-local persistence. The assertion continues to read the interrupted Factory Session through the public HTTP contract, verifies INTERRUPTED plus interruption lifecycle data, and now rejects both the durable-session snapshot and its parent directory. No product durability code changed because the evidence still shows the default policy is correctly in-memory-only. Focused no-snapshot runs passed once and five consecutive times; all three durability resume scenarios passed together; go vet and git diff --check passed. Sibling fresh-run and race evidence remain in story 003.
